<!--
  The cart drawer in its open state, over a faded page: the head with a close button, the lines with a quantity
  field, the free-delivery bar, the totals and the button. The empty state shows an icon, a line and the way
  back. Static markup: opening and closing are the page's. Axes: state (filled, empty), media (image, none).
-->
<script lang="ts">
import type { DrawerLabels } from "./cart-drawer.types";
import type { CartLine, CartLabels } from "./cart-list.types";
import type { SummaryRow } from "./order-summary.types";

export type CartDrawerProps = {
  id: string;
  lines: CartLine[];
  rows: SummaryRow[];
  labels: CartLabels;
  drawer: DrawerLabels;
  state?: "filled" | "empty";
  media?: "image" | "none";
  landmarkLabel?: string;
};
</script>

<script setup lang="ts">
import Block from "../primitives/block/block.vue";
import Box from "../primitives/box/box.vue";
import Button from "../primitives/button/button.vue";
import Container from "../primitives/container/container.vue";
import Group from "../primitives/group/group.vue";
import LucideIcon from "../primitives/lucide-icon/lucide-icon.vue";
import Stack from "../primitives/stack/stack.vue";
import Text from "../primitives/text/text.vue";
import Title from "../primitives/title/title.vue";
import DrawerLines from "../components/drawer-lines.vue";
import { tpl } from "../utils";

const {
  id,
  lines,
  rows,
  labels,
  drawer,
  state = "filled",
  media = "image",
  landmarkLabel,
} = defineProps<CartDrawerProps>();
</script>

<template>
  <Block tag="section" class="py-8" :aria-label="(landmarkLabel ?? drawer.title)" data-testid="section">
    <Container class="mx-auto w-full max-w-6xl px-4" data-slot="container">
      <Box class="flex min-h-160 overflow-hidden rounded bg-muted inset-ring inset-ring-border">
        <Box class="hidden flex-1 flex-col gap-4 p-8 sm:flex" aria-hidden="true">
          <Box class="h-8 w-48 rounded bg-background" />
          <Box class="h-40 rounded bg-background" />
          <Box class="h-40 rounded bg-background" />
        </Box>
        <Box
          class="flex w-full flex-col bg-background shadow-lg sm:max-w-sm"
          role="group"
          :aria-label="drawer.title"
          data-testid="drawer"
        >
          <Group gap="4" align="center" justify="between" class="border-b border-border p-4">
            <Title :as="2" size="lg" weight="semibold">
              {{ drawer.title }}
            </Title>
            <Button variant="ghost" size="sm" layout="icon" :aria-label="drawer.close">
              <LucideIcon name="x" :size="16" />
            </Button>
          </Group>
          <Stack
            v-if="((state as string) === 'empty')"
            gap="4"
            align="center"
            class="flex-1 justify-center p-8 text-center"
            data-testid="empty"
          >
            <LucideIcon name="shopping-bag" :size="32" />
            <Text size="base" weight="semibold">
              {{ drawer.empty }}
            </Text>
            <Text size="sm" class="text-muted-foreground">
              {{ drawer.emptyText }}
            </Text>
            <Button variant="outline" size="default">
              {{ drawer.browse }}
            </Button>
          </Stack>
          <DrawerLines v-else
            :field="tpl('{0}-qty', id)"
            :lines="lines"
            :rows="rows"
            :labels="labels"
            :drawer="drawer"
            :media="media"
          />
        </Box>
      </Box>
    </Container>
  </Block>
</template>
